name: Svrnty Team Setup
description: Multi-agent orchestration via Overstory + Beads task tracking + Mulch knowledge persistence
long_description: Svrnty Team Setup converts Claude Code into a multi-agent orchestration platform. It uses Overstory for agent spawning into isolated git worktrees, Beads for git-backed issue/task tracking, and Mulch for structured knowledge persistence across sessions. Native Claude Code Task and TeamCreate tools are blocked by hooks — all agent work flows through Overstory for proper worktree isolation and dashboard visibility.

optional.name: bun
optional.description: JavaScript runtime for Overstory (auto-installed by setup.sh)

features.title: Overstory Agent Orchestration
features.description: Spawn agents into isolated git worktrees with overstory sling, monitor via live TUI dashboard

features.title: Beads Task Tracking
features.description: Git-backed issue/task tracking with dependencies, priorities, and agent assignment

features.title: Mulch Knowledge Persistence
features.description: Structured expertise recording and retrieval across sessions and agents

features.title: 4-Tier Merge Protocol
features.description: Fast-forward, auto-merge, AI-assisted, and reimagine merge strategies

features.title: Agent Mail System
features.description: SQLite-backed inter-agent messaging with types, priorities, and payloads

features.title: Hook System
features.description: 9 hooks across 8 events: block native agents, enforce worktree boundaries, auto-sync on stop
